cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Recruit Them Twice
cards.instruction: Recruit them to your side, then reveal that the side, goal, or conflict is not what it first appeared to be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Will you help me tidy the committee cupboard?

beats.speaker: A

beats.text: I agreed to tidy, not overthrow.

mechanism: Copy crossed-out names as removal orders, recruit help clearing records, then recast the corrected attendance marks into a campaign to remove the committee members themselves.
confusable: Not just a surprise coup: B2 must expose A's mistaken copied marks and A must recruit again through that same corrected information.
comparison: Club records and attendance-based challenge rather than a garden plan turning against its own signatories.
seedUse: Retains cupboard tidying to committee replacement; uses crossed-out absent members as the mistaken administrative seed.
